pl-echinodorus-horizontalis.title: Brazilian Sword (emersed)
pl-echinodorus-horizontalis.summary: Brazilian Sword (emersed) is a roots-in-water / pond-margin plant with slow growth (easy care).
rows: Roots-in-water (emersed / pond margin; not a fully submerged aquarium plant)
Pond margin / emersed planter (roots in water)
Heavy. Grown with roots in water or damp soil; not an underwater carpet plant
Root and water feeding. Nutrient-rich water or soil helps
Divide the rhizome into pieces with a few leaves or fronds each
notes: Keep roots wet; leaves prefer air. Not a fully submerged aquarium plant.
Fewer independent public profiles exist for this cultivar; fields stick to what the available source states.
warn: Not for fully submerged long-term use unless the species is known to adapt underwater.
